match_id: HURZELER: “WORST TIMING FOR THAT KIND OF PERFORMANCE!”  Brighton_Man Utd_2026-05-24_88y6pg0dZsU
team: HURZELER: “WORST TIMING FOR THAT KIND OF PERFORMANCE!”  Brighton
speaker: Head Coach
quote_text:
Fabian is that... Congratulations on achieving  something, but what happened in the game? What  
is your emotion after that? Yeah, like you said, I  think mixed feelings. On one side, it is the worst  
timing for that kind of performance. On the other  side, when you reflect on the season and you take  
the overall season, then it is definitely an  achievement because we are Brighton and, for a  
second time now, we are in Europe. So that is  why we should see it more as an achievement.  
Do you understand? You have only been at the  club for a short amount of time, but you will  
know about the history. And so a day like today  is kind of almost still unbelievable, even though  
the club is a completely different club to the  one that you joined. That is why I think it is  
very important to see where we came from and  to see our development in the last years, to  
see the players working hard to improve. The club  always tries to find small steps where we can get  
the most potential out of everyone. So I see the  daily business from the players. I see how hard  
they are working for this achievement, and that is  why I think it is another milestone in the history  
of this club. It is another great individual  achievement from the players and therefore, like  
I said, we should be proud of the overall season.  And for you in particular, was qualification for  
Europe something that you were determined to  do? Because obviously Roberto de Zerbi did  
that before you. Yeah, I do not try to replicate  the achievements from the coaches here before,  
because Roberto de Zerbi was a great coach for  Brighton and he achieved unbelievable things with  
this club. He set the base, the foundation for  all the success that we could have in the last  
two years. Therefore, we finished last season  eighth, we finished now eighth, and that shows  
that we are consistent in this area where we can  challenge the establishment, and that is also what  
we should do for the following years. Can I just  start with the bad first before the very good?  
Can you put your finger on that performance when  there was so much at stake? Yeah, it is difficult  
to find one particular reason why we had this  performance. I think overall we started well,  
we created moments. Then, of course, there was  one corner and then we conceded the goal. I think  
the bad thing from us was that we did not react  well to the goals we conceded. We did not stay in  
our structure. We tried to immediately react  to things, and normally we should stay calm,  
or we stay calm, we act, we try to stick to our  principles. What we did not expect was from us. So  
you have these kind of days. Like I said, it was  the worst timing for these kind of performances.  
But in two, three days, after I reflect on  everything, after I calm a little bit down, then  
I will try to see as well the positives, and there  are also plenty of positives from this season.  
And the second thing is the Europa Conference  League is a new thing for this club and it is  
a new thing for you. Yeah, it is another great  opportunity to prove how far we are as a team,  
to make the next step. Of course it is a new  experience. We will face different teams. But  
like I said, we have to face this opportunity with  a lot of positivity, with a great togetherness,  
with a good work ethic, and then we see  what happens and where it takes us. Fabian,  
how much are you looking forward to expanding  the squad then a little bit in terms of taking  
that next step, when you have the Conference  League as well? What do you think? Yeah,  
it is important now, like I said, to analyse the  squad, to get understanding what was good, what  
was bad, what do we need, where do we need to have  improvements. We have some contracts running out,  
so there will be a lot of planning for the next  season. But like I said, we are a well-structured  
club. I really trust Tony and Paul and Mike  and Jason that we will do the right steps,  
what is important for the club, and then I am  looking forward to this challenge. James Milner,  
do you have any comments on his future, do you  think? Yeah, let us wait for the next stage,  
because I think first of all we really want  to speak about the season. We want to reflect  
everyone's performance and then, first of all,  I think it is very important that we give every  
player each individual feedback, and including  this feedback also the James Milner topic,  
and then we see what happens. Carlos started the  last four matches for you but not today. Can you  
tell us a bit about that decision and playing an  experienced midfield ahead of him? Yeah, I think  
Carlos struggled a little bit last week in the  game against Leeds United regarding physicality,  
regarding his condition, and also during the week  he felt quite tired. So that is why we made this  
change. We know that Carlos gives us something  special, but overall it was also a decision for  
experience, like you said, and trying to bring  players on the pitch that were there during the  
season when we had this bad run. I think we should  not forget this. So overall I really trusted the  
team. I trusted everyone who was starting today.  In the end, afterwards, you always know more,  
so you can judge these decisions. But we went into  the game with a lot of conviction. There was a lot  
of speculation with Baleba and Manchester United.  Would you still like to work with him next season,  
and what do you see in his future? One hundred  per cent. Can I just ask you about your season?  
What is the biggest step forward you think you  have taken, and maybe the biggest one that you  
have not managed to take? That is a good question.  I think we faced a lot of adversity, a lot of  
tough periods, and we always stuck together.  I think I always had the belief in this group,  
and definitely in these times where it is not  that successful and you try to fight for getting  
the right result, you really have to stick to  your idea, to your principles. That is what we  
did as a team. That is what I did as a coach.  So it is really important to trust the things  
I am convinced of, and therefore I learned a lot  regarding this. The thing I might change is this  
game today. So, of course, we wanted to go to the  Europa League. But in the end, I am a young coach.  
I always try to reflect on myself, my decisions,  trying to get better, trying to work better with  
the staff, work better with the players. So there  is always improvement and it is progress, and that  
is a process also I am in. So that is why I think  it is so important now to reflect everything, to  
see the positive and the negative, to be honest to  myself, what was good, what was bad, and I cannot  
point this or that out. I think it is a process  where I will never be 100 per cent satisfied.  
That is what I know, because it is just inside of  my body. That is just my attitude, to always try  
to improve things. So I will analyse it together  with my team, together with the club, and then the  
main things I try to change, but also try to keep  positive things. Can you go back to why Wieffer  
did not start there? That is quite surprising.  Yeah, it was just team selection. So of course  
Mats Wieffer is a player who helped us a lot in  the last weeks, but that was a decision we made.
title: HURZELER: “WORST TIMING FOR THAT KIND OF PERFORMANCE!”  Brighton 0-3 Man Utd
